response_contract.scientific_semantics: The NHESS article cites Zenodo 11064781 as 'Radar data for 12 hail events in Switzerland'. MESHS is an inferred radar hail-size indicator, not direct point-measured hailstone size, a building-damage vulnerability function, or a stochastic event frequency. Review upstream MeteoSwiss rights separately from the paper license and Zenodo record; verify NetCDF/other format, CRS, cell size, units, nodata and event-year identity. No OEP/AEP or insurer loss calibration is warranted by 12 selected historical events. Resolve MeteoSwiss upstream derivative rights for exact released grids. MESHS mm and POH percent are different radar proxies, not measured ground hail. Preserve coordinate and time keys; selected events not a climatology.
